text: APPROVE. The loop body is split into `MergeReportRows` and `SumBranchTotals`, which drops the method's nesting and branching well below 15. The behaviour is the same: merge happens first, partial BRF/BRH totals survive an `IOException`, and the CHA0004 suppression moves with the catch. I see nothing that would break the build, though I only had the diff, not a build. The new locals `f` and `h` sit in the loop-body scope, and the old `out var f`/`h` sat in a nested scope inside it, so no new name conflict arises.
